name: emoji-scale
title: Emoji scale
description: Five faces from awful to great as a real radio group, named for screen readers, with a quiet pop when chosen and no colour to tell them apart.
docs: value is the number of the chosen face, 1 (awful) to 5 (great), or null for none; onValueChange reports the number. labels replaces the five words, worst first, and each one names its face for assistive technology: a screen reader hears "Good, 4 of 5". The faces differ in shape and not in colour (squeezed eyes and a deep frown, a small frown, a flat mouth, a small smile, laughing eyes over an open smile), so they read in monochrome and for colour-blind people. The chosen face fills its disc and grows a little, which is skipped under reduced motion. Pointing at or focusing a face writes its word under the row in a quieter weight without choosing it; showLabels={false} leaves that line out and the words stay in the accessible names. The chosen word is announced politely. size is sm, md or lg (24, 32 or 40px faces); every face sits in a target of 44px or more, and on a narrow screen the faces close up instead of running off the side. name sends the number with a plain form, and required marks the group.
